description: Ministry of Education - Appoint Dr. C. S. Lewangamage to be the Competent Authority - University of Moratuwa
reasoning: This gazette content involves the appointment of Dr. Chamindalal Sujeewa Lewangamage as Competent Authority for the Institute of Technology, University of Moratuwa under the Universities Act. This constitutes a judicial/law enforcement matter as it relates to the appointment of an administrative authority to exercise powers in an educational institution due to administrative failure, falling under Type 9 (Judicial/Law Enforcement Gazettes) which covers court appointments, judicial matters, and administrative authorities exercising legal powers.
